explication: React on Rails embeds React in Rails applications: a Rails view invokes a helper to render a registered component, sends props through server rendering, and delivers HTML that the browser hydrates. The OSS runtime provides Rails-oriented SSR and client rendering; Pro adds Node rendering, streaming, React Server Components, caching, and TanStack Router SSR. Generators and Shakapacker integration support app setup and bundle workflows. The README documents these capabilities, but sampled source is limited, so links among unsampled subsystems are not asserted.
